page.overview:
Who is Satchels Maffey?

Saint Satchels Maffey is a World Noble and a member of the Knights of God 38 years ago. She took part in the God Valley Incident, and was responsible for Shanks and Shamrock splitting up. It is unknown if she is still working as a Knight of God in the current day.

Maffey is a massive woman, towering over her already-large comrades. She has sharpened teeth, wears lipstick, and was frequently seen with a cigar in her mouth. 38 years ago, she had long light and dark hair, which split down the middle, and was fashioned up to look as though it were a crown, as well as dark sunglasses and a pair of horns. She wore an open V-neck frilled shirt, exposing her cleavage and midriff, and two belts above her navel area, as well as a floral skirt and bands around her forearms. She also wore a large fur coat over her shoulders. It seems she wore high heels when Edward Newgate cut her in half.

Like all World Nobles, and similar to other Knights of God, Maffey exhibits a personality of very low morals, accompanied by a mocking, flirtatious tone. She cares very little about the lives of others, and was fully prepared to end the life of a young Monkey D. Dragon for mutiny, without any qualms. Nevertheless, she was happy to do one of her allies a favor, and quickly accomplished her task of reacquiring Shamrock. However, either through bad intel or because she was in a hurry, she did not bother to check if Shanks was even present or if Dragon was truly dead.

Being a World Noble of the Satchels family, Maffey is above the law of the lower world and is permitted to do anything she pleases, so long as it does not go against the laws of the Celestial Dragons. She has tremendous political influence and can summon a Marine Admiral to handle anyone she feels is trying to bring harm to her. However, being one of the Knights of God, she likely possesses more than sufficient combat prowess to defend herself without the needs of an Admiral.
